notes: Code Mode runs the agent's task as ONE generated program that calls the tools as a typed API, instead of a big tool list taken over many round trips.
The tool API is a faithful replay of the recorded trace: each (tool, args) returns the exact recorded output, deterministically. No live model, no network, no GPU.

MEASURED = produced by actually running the locked-down sandbox (wall time, CPU seconds, peak RSS, exit status, and that the network / out-of-dir writes were refused). The sandbox blocks network (unshare -n when the kernel allows it, else a socket-refusing audit hook), caps CPU/memory/wall time, and forbids writes outside a temp dir.
TOKENIZER = a count of the generated program and its final result using the repo's chars//4 approximation (route/stack.py). It is bytes we hold, not a billed model figure.

ESTIMATE = the single model round trip Code Mode implies and the model-side latency/energy of emitting the program: no live model is called here, so these are modelled, not measured. Sandbox CPU-package energy is read from RAPL when readable, else left null with the reason.
